title: E Gene Amplification Protocol
author: Bo Yi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zpuf5nw

steps.title: Extract viral RNA
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from the dengue virus strains obtained from cell culture using the TGuide S32 magnetic bead DNA/RNA extraction kit (Tiangen Biochemical Technology, Beijing).

steps.title: Set up one‑step RT‑PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare a one‑step RT‑PCR reaction using the One‑Step RNA PCR Kit (Code No DRR057A, Bao Bioengineering, Dalian) and add the following primers: forward primer D1 (E) F – CAA GAA CCG AAA CA / GT GGA TGT C; reverse primer D1 (E) R – GGC TGA TCG AAT TCC ACA CAC. The expected amplicon length is 1849 bp.

steps.title: Run thermal cycling program
steps.instruction: Run the RT‑PCR with these conditions: reverse transcription at 50 °C for 30 min; initial denaturation at 94 °C for 2 min; then 40 cycles of 94 °C for 30 s, 52 °C for 30 s, and 72 °C for 2 min; finish with a final extension at 72 °C (duration as per kit instructions).

steps.title: Confirm product by gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Take 5 µL of the amplified product and run it on a 1.5 % agarose gel electrophoresis alongside a DNA marker to verify the expected band size.
